summary: Bulk Update Time and material timecards
description: Bulk update Time and material timecards with one request.

schema.description: Array of Time and material timecards

id.description: Unique identifier of the Time & Material timecard.

hours_worked.description: Total hours worked for this timecard entry.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this timecard.

time_and_material_entry_id.description: Identifier of the Time & Material entry this timecard belongs to.

timecard_time_type_id.description: Identifier of the time type (e.g., Regular Time, Overtime) applied to this timecard.

work_classification_id.description: Identifier of the worker's trade or work classification.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this timecard was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this timecard was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this timecard was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this timecard.

login.description: Email address of the user who created this timecard.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this timecard.

name.description: Full name of the user this timecard is for.

login_information_id.description: Identifier of the user this timecard is for.
